messages:
Alex G: starting handoff — quick recap of last 3 hours: regional network blips in us-west-2 causing intermittent 502/504s on the inference proxy. PagerDuty triggered ~3:12am PT, we routed traffic to fallback pool and limited model variants.

ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — 502 spike detected (us-west-2). AlertID: INC-20260315-47. Symptoms: upstream LB connection resets -> 502s surfaced to customers, p95 gen latency increased ~2x.

Jamie T: i'm primary for this shift, tagging @Sara N as secondary. coverage note: Maria P is OOO until 6pm PT but available on call if needed.

Sara N: noted, i'm on deck. saw the temporary reroute to graveyard pool — did that auto-failover complete?

Alex G: it did, but the graveyard pool has lower capacity; we saw increased queueing. Temporary mitigations applied: 1) route-by-latency to eu fallback for non-EU customers where possible, 2) enabled degraded model variant (quantized v2) for small payloads, 3) increased batching threshold to 32ms to improve throughput.

Jamie T: customer impact summary for handoff: about 2.3% of requests in us-west-2 returned 502/504 during peak (3:05-3:20am PT). No data loss, no auth issues. Major customers experienced increased retry rates; support notified.

Sara N: copied. Are runbooks up-to-date? which one did we follow?

Alex G: followed runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/region-route-failover (section 2: degraded routing). Note: there was a missing step re: cache warmup for fallback pool — added note in ops ticket.

Maria P: FYI i pushed a minimal doc update to that runbook while I had access. Also created ticket INFRA-3487 to investigate LB healthcheck flapping.

Jamie T: current status at handoff: traffic split steady, us-west-2 error rate down to ~0.4% in last 15m, p95 latency slowly trending to baseline. Fallback pool capacity still constrained under sustained load.

ops-bot: METRIC SNAPSHOT: 3:40am PT -> errors(us-west-2): 0.4%, p95 latency overall: 310ms (baseline 180ms), queue depth on fallback: 12.

Sara N: open action items for next shift: 1) follow up on INFRA-3487 (LB healthchecks), 2) coordinate with infra to add more machines to fallback pool if >1% error persists, 3) run a controlled failover rehearsal in staging for the routing play.

Alex G: adding: 4) postmortem draft owner = Jamie T, due +72h; 5) update alert run thresholds to reduce noisy paging (see proposal in incident ticket).

Jamie T: taking postmortem. I'll start the skeleton after this handoff, will ping for any logs we need.

Sara N: for immediate next steps I recommend leaving degraded model variant enabled for 1 hour, then revert if error <0.5% and p95 < 1.5x baseline. Also enable prefix cache priming on fallback nodes to reduce cold-start latency (see runbook section 4).

Alex G: good. Also flagged potential coverage gap: night shift does not have permission to scale the fallback pool in prod — that caused a 10min delay earlier. We need a short-term ACL exception or a documented oncall escalation path to infra.

Maria P: opened ACL request IR-5321 and added a temporary sudo play for oncall leads, expires in 7 days. Put details in INFRA-3487.

Jamie T: outstanding: notify support & account execs for customers with >1% error rate. Sara, can you draft the support blurb?

Sara N: will do. Short note: "We experienced intermittent 502/504s in us-west-2 between 03:05-03:20 PT due to upstream LB instability. Failovers were applied; service is stable. We're investigating permanent fixes. If you continue to see errors, please escalate."

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT NOTE — no deploys to inference-proxy in last 6 hours.

Alex G: handoff checklist: primary = Jamie T, secondary = Sara N, infra pager = Maria P, coverage gap = prod scaling perms (IR-5321 open), runbook updates = done (minor), postmortem = Jamie T.

Jamie T: I have the pager, will monitor next 2 hours then hand off to Sara for afternoon. If error rate creeps >1% re-escalate to infra immediately. Leaving monitoring queries below:

Jamie T: ```
# quick queries
errors: sum(rate(http_errors{region=\"us-west-2\"}[5m]))
p95: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
queue: avg(queue_depth{pool=\"fallback\"})
```

Sara N: thanks — i'll pick up at 11:00am PT. Next steps for follow-up: verify LB fix from infra, confirm fallback pool autoscale policy, update runbook with scaling permission step, and complete postmortem review.

Alex G: closing handoff. TL;DR: transient LB flapping caused 2.3% errors briefly, mitigations applied, error rate reduced to 0.4%, action items tracked (INFRA-3487, IR-5321, postmortem). Primary: Jamie T, Secondary: Sara N. Ping me if any escalation. :thumbsup:
